title: Human aversion? Do AI Agents Judge Identity More Harshly Than Performance

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting an LLM to synthesize predictions from two sources (labeled as 'human' or 'machine learning algorithm') and calculating the actual weight assigned to each source's advice using the relative distance to the LLM's final prediction, while controlling for prior error rates.

Systematically varying the presentation order of the human and machine learning agents in the input prompts to measure whether the first-positioned advisor receives disproportionate weight in the LLM's final decision.
